text:
Maya (People Ops): @here Quick reminder — self-assessments are due end of day next Friday (2026-04-10). Please submit via the form: https://redwoodhr.company/forms/self-assess. We need these ahead of manager calibration week so managers can do read-aheads.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Are we still including promotion intent in the self-assessment or is that a separate doc?

Maya (People Ops): Include promotion intent on the self-assessment (there's a checkbox + short justification field). Managers will flag folks for calibration if they check 'promotion consideration'.

Riley (Product): I'm on PTO from Tue-Thu next week — could I get a 48h extension? My manager said yes but wanted the formal request logged.

Luis (People Ops): Yep — we have a built-in 48h grace for approved PTO. Riley, can you paste the manager approval here or use the "extension request" button on the form? Link: https://redwoodhr.company/forms/self-assess/extensions

Riley (Product): Pasted manager DM below: "approved, will review when back". Thanks!

Ava (IC): Small question — do we need to attach examples of work? Or just bullets?

Maya (People Ops): Bullets are fine. If you're submitting promotion intent, add 1–2 linked artifacts (PRs, designs, customer feedback). Don't attach huge files — links preferred.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Where will managers see everyone's submissions? Is there a consolidated spreadsheet or is it per-team?

Maya (People Ops): Managers get a consolidated view in the Calibration dashboard (Console -> Reviews -> Calibration). We'll also export a summary CSV for managers on Monday morning.

Sam (HR Bot): Automated reminder: 3 days left to submit self-assessments. Visit https://redwoodhr.company/forms/self-assess to complete.

Luis (People Ops): Heads up to managers: calibration facilitator training is Thurs 4/9 at 10am PT — calendar invite sent. If you can't make it, email me and I'll share the facilitator notes.

Ava (IC): Quick FYI — if anyone needs sample language for strengths/areas to improve, see this snippet I used: "Strength: shipped reliable infra that reduced token costs by 22% (PR #834). Area: want to improve cross-team communication — plan: biweekly syncs." Saved me time.

Maya (People Ops): Love that example, @Ava. We're also publishing a short checklist + sample phrases in the docs channel later today. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks — will nudge the team. One last ask: if a manager disagrees with a self-assessment rating before calibration, should they edit or wait for calibration?

Maya (People Ops): Managers should not edit an individual's self-assessment. Add manager notes in the Manager Notes section and save. Calibration is where rating changes are proposed and agreed.

Luis (People Ops): If anyone needs a formal extension beyond 48h for extenuating circumstances, use the extensions form and cc your manager — approvals are handled case-by-case.

Riley (Product): Got it, thanks all. Submitted the form with manager note.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. We'll post the calibration schedule and facilitator notes by EOD Monday. :calendar:
